stage.name: Victory Rewind
stage.description:
Characters and events flash before your eyes as time rewinds. This backtrack is necessary and inevitable for another possible ending, but it shouldn't be this way. Nothing should be absolutely inevitable.
<Originium Ice Crystals> that continuously apply [Cold] are present on the field
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

sarkaz_maze_returner.name: Sarkaz Maze Returner
sarkaz_maze_returner.flavourText: A Wendigo warrior bound by a promise to his homeland. The heavy tombstone on his back, engraved with the names of his kindred, has often forced him to his knees, but even more often compelled him to rise.
abilities: Attacks hit 2 times when on a Mark of Epoch.

infused_glacial_originium_slug_enemy_106.name: Infused Glacial Originium Slug
infused_glacial_originium_slug_enemy_106.flavourText: An infected wild creature native to colder environments that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen. Upon death, they will explode and freeze nearby Operators. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by Yeti Squadron members for various tactical purposes.
abilities: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and applies Cold to affected targets

yeti_caster_leader.name: Yeti Caster Leader
yeti_caster_leader.flavourText: An elite caster of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra, boasting greater combat capabilities. Through special Arts and devices, they can inflict Cold on our Operators, reducing their attack speed and making them vulnerable to being Frozen.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack applies the Cold effect

yeti_operative.name: Yeti Operative
yeti_operative.flavourText: A basic melee combatants of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected guerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. They are skilled at attacking frozen Operators.
abilities: Attack power increases when attacking Frozen targets

sarkaz_guerrilla_caster.name: Sarkaz Guerrilla Caster
sarkaz_guerrilla_caster.flavourText: A Sarkaz Caster who supports Patriot but cannot understand the special terminology of their guerilla operations. The Sarkaz ritual maintained by the Sarkaz Originium Altars will not damage them, instead strengthening their bodies and converting their attacks into Arts damage.
abilities: Casts Arts periodically, dealing Arts damage equivalent to unit's ATK to all surrounding units
When coming into contact with a Pulse Wave, this unit instead takes no damage and their attack range expands

yeti_icecleaver_leader.name: Yeti Icecleaver Leader
yeti_icecleaver_leader.flavourText: A special melee combatant of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected gerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Experienced executioners on the battlefield, they wield long katanas that can easily ravage frozen Operators, and their nickname, 'Ice Cleaver,' references their devastating blows that seem strong enough to split glaciers.
abilities: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets

frostnova_winters_scar.name: FrostNova, 'Winter's Scar'
frostnova_winters_scar.flavourText: Leader of the Yeti Squadron, she has released the remainder of what little life force she has left in preparation for the final battle. The biting cold of the land has already been released; are we truly prepared to make an enemy out of it?
abilities: Normal attacks and Ice Nova deal Arts damage and applies Cold to targets
Ice Nova deals double damage to Frozen targets
Initially Invulnerable for a period of time during the second form, attacks and skills become stronger

patriot.name: Patriot
patriot.flavourText: His armor is in disrepair and damaged in many places. The blade of his once sharp halberd is now eroded with rust. However, the indomitable Patriot never capitulates, never backs down, and never shows mercy. He has long struggled with fate, and now resolves to slit the throat of fate.
abilities: Greatly increases the ATK and DEF of enemy units
Marching Stance
Gains greatly increased ATK, DEF, and RES. Becomes more likely to be targeted by your units, and normal attacks strike 4 times
Enters a revival state when HP drops to 0, continuously dealing True damage to units around him. After a period of time, enters Ruination stance
Ruination Stance
Can perform long-ranged attacks
Deals Physical damage to the farthest high ground unit
Continuously deals True damage to allied units within range
Immune to Stun, Frozen, and Levitate

lost_contraption.name: Lost Contraption
lost_contraption.flavourText: An automated thought collector built by a lost Kazdelian empire. It has continuously operated for so long that its movements have become slow and haphazard.
abilities: Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

portal.name: 'Portal'
portal.flavourText: A portal that follows the living and can occasionally be encountered in the Furnace. Do not fear if it compels you to enter, for it has already prepared an exit.
abilities: Temporarily removes an Operator from the squad when it disappears.

devices.description: More likely to be attacked; once defeated, drops 1 Plan
